parameter_semantics.overview: All Candidate A configs use fielded sparse+dense union/hybrid + exact title/org/entity + explicit field weighting + duplicate/diversification. No new signal/model/embedding. Scoring is deterministic, no adaptive generation.

dedup_cosine_threshold.semantics: cosine similarity above which duplicate is suppressed

exact_org_boost.semantics: additive boost when query matches org

exact_title_boost.semantics: additive boost when query exactly matches title substring

field_weight_title.semantics: multiplier for count_title in weighted lexical overlap

fusion_method.semantics: union = sparse top-100 + dense top-100 union then weighted score; hybrid_weighted_sum = same union but final_score is weighted sum (described). Both satisfy union/hybrid; distinction controls whether pool is union only vs weighted sum already; in this plan both map to same final_score formula, enum documents intent for implementation audit.

sparse_weight.semantics: multiplier for weighted lexical overlap (lexical_bias analog)

scoring_order_and_normalization.determinism: All steps deterministic: same qvec, same per-field counts, same scoring formula, same tie-breaks, same dedup threshold comparison, same MMR order. No randomness, no result-dependent branching.
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_1_query_normalization: q = strip_region(raw_query) (ml-service/app.py:strip_region); lexical terms = lexical_overlap_terms(q) (source_ranking.py); embedding = SentenceTransformer(intfloat/multilingual-e5-base).encode(['query: '+q], normalize_embeddings=True)[0]
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_2_dense: dense_cosine = 1 - (c.embedding <=> qvec) via pgvector cosine distance; range ~[-1,1] but normalized embeddings yields ~[0,1]; dense_score = dense_weight * dense_cosine; dense_weight in {0.9,1.0,1.1} (unitless multiplier, baseline 1.0)
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_3_sparse_field_weighted: Per-field distinct lexical overlap counts: count_title = DISTINCT term ILIKE title, count_support = DISTINCT term ILIKE support_content||' '||summary||' '||keywords, count_eligibility = DISTINCT term ILIKE add_qualify||' '||income_etc||' '||apply_method. Weighted lexical overlap = field_weight_title*count_title + field_weight_support_content*count_support + field_weight_eligibility*count_eligibility. field_weights are multipliers (baseline 1.0). sparse_score = sparse_weight * weighted_lexical_overlap. sparse_weight (lexical_bias analog) in {0.005,0.01,0.02}. This generalizes baseline LEXICAL_OVERLAP_BIAS=0.01 * single count to weighted per-field.
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_4_exact_signals: Exact signals are additive boosts (unitless, added to score before ordering). is_exact_title = 1 if NFC+strip+casefold normalized q equals or is substring of normalized title with length >=4 and word-boundary or exact equality, else 0. is_exact_org = 1 if normalized org appears as substring in q or vice versa with length >=2, else 0. exact_title_boost in {0.0,0.07,0.15}; exact_org_boost in {0.0,0.05,0.10}; exact_entity_boost fixed 0.0 (entity not separate from title/org in current schema; reserved for future but not instantiated in this plan). Boosts added: exact_score = exact_title_boost*is_exact_title + exact_org_boost*is_exact_org.
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_5_youth_bias_preserved: youth_source_bias remains fixed per baseline (0.015 when youth terms without Gov24 orgs); not a tunable axis in this plan; included in final_score as subtractive distance bias mapped to score: youth_score = youth_bias (0 or 0.015) added to score (since baseline subtracts from distance, equivalent to adding to score).
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_6_final_score: final_score = dense_score + sparse_score + exact_score + youth_score. No additional normalization beyond weights; ordering is by final_score desc. Tie-break deterministic: final_score desc, source asc, source_id asc, policy.id asc.
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_7_retrieval_pool: Sparse and dense each retrieve top-100 by their own signal (dense by dense_cosine, sparse by weighted lexical overlap), exact signal is scoring boost not separate retrieval pool. Union = union of dense top-100 + sparse top-100 (deduplicated by policy id, keep max per-signal rank). Candidate pool for reranking is union (max 200). Final ranking sorts union pool by final_score. This satisfies sparse+dense union/hybrid contract.
scoring_order_and_normalization.step_8_dedup_diversification: After scoring union pool: dedup: if cosine similarity between any two policy embeddings > dedup_cosine_threshold (0.95/0.97/0.98), keep higher final_score, drop lower (deterministic). Then diversification: if diversification_lambda >0, apply MMR-like penalty: diversification_score = lambda*final_score - (1-lambda)*max_similarity_to_already_selected; lambda 0.0 means no diversification (final_score only), lambda 0.3 means light MMR. Selection iterates picking highest diversification_score for top-5. Diversification computed on policy embeddings (cosine).
